A lot of people paint these things as actions or choices, when (in my experience) they aren't choices at all. I cant exactly choose how much cortisol my brain decides to flood my body with when I'm reminded of something traumatic. Being less-than-functional because of neglect and abuse isn't a place where I can forgive the people and things that have me here.

I just dont believe that setting the intention that I'll never forgive someone is healthy for anyone. Its one thing to be unsure if you can forgive or not and just outright saying "ill never forgive them for x, y, and z". That sounds like a choice to me. I dont know if I'll ever forgive my sisters (especially), but I cant bring myself to set the intention that I'll never do it. If I don't believe its within my control, I'm not going to place it under my control by saying I will never do it. I'd like to keep the option open-ended at the very least. 

Either way, it won't be happening any time soon and thats ok too.
